change: computeCount: when a start/end register that holds a known constant (checkForImmediate) is not available in the preheader (its def does not dominate it, e.g. 'ADDI $x0, 256' left in the loop latch because an exit phi uses the same constant), use the immediate instead, as HexagonHardwareLoops::computeCount does for A2_tfrsi (lines 743-756 at llvmorg-20.1.8). Registers that are available keep being used, so all previously valid code is unchanged.
rule8: Pre-existing fork defect.
